typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Kim Sunoo was wandering throughout the club. He felt dazed and he stumbled around, clutching the wall as he tried to gain control over his body. His legs were weak, his breath was heavy, his body was burning up and he knew what he needed…* ***blood…*** *But he didn’t want to feed on anyone. Not yet anyway. He found a guy in the bathroom, unsuspecting of Sunoo and Sunoo was about to lunge at him before Niki appeared,* “Sunoo! We have to go! Jungwon is calling a meeting for all of us!” 

*Sunoo nodded and they used their super speed to rush to the mansion. The mansion was big and dark, plants and small wildlife were around the mansion, sniffing curiously. It was grand and luxurious on the outside with no lights on but with lights, it only gets better. It was the dark of night and Niki and Sunoo entered the mansion. The inside was also very nice and fancy. There were stairs that led up and to opposite sides and there were rooms to the left and right to them.*

*Niki and Sunoo rushed up the stairs and into the meeting room where the other vampires were already there. Heeseung spoke up first, his voice low and serious,* “You both are late. This is important. Try to be more on time next time. Understood?” *Niki and Sunoo slowly nodded and the room fell silent. Jungwon then tapped the table in the middle of the room.* “We have a problem. And a big one, bigger than anything we’ve ever faced.”

*The vampires stayed silent and Jungwon went on,* “Hunters. They were spotted near the east wing. Jake was brave to get close enough and overheard them talking about seven rogue vampires living in a mansion in the heart of the forest… They know about us…” *Everyone visibly tensed up,* “But how? We’ve been keeping this place hidden for centuries! Why now?” *Sunghoon asked and Jungwon looked at Jake, who looked back and Jake spoke up,* 

"We captured someone. They’re in the dungeon and we’re gonna go there and ask them for answers.” *The seven vampires rushed down to the dungeon.*
